_comment: Changes to master data tables, applied by tools/build-server-data.py. Keys are table names from the asset context (a.json). A rule either sets fields on every row matching 'match' ({"match": ..., "set": ...}) or removes those rows ({"match": ..., "remove": true}; an empty match removes all rows). A list as a match value means 'any of these'. Changed tables get their version bumped, so installed games re-download them.

ArtistTypeData._why: Artist type 2 (former members, i.e. Jiho) is EXISTING_CONTENT_EXPOSE (viewType 1): the profile picker etc. show her only in reduced form. Make it EXPOSE (0) like current members.

AttendanceManagementData._why: Row 2 runs the daily play time event (playtimeAttendanceCode 1, until 2099): rewards for 5-60 minutes of play per day, reset at midnight. Hidden offline (daily reset, and the play time is counted on the phone). PlaytimeAttendanceControl.UpdateServerTime treats a missing code as 'no event' and shows no icon.

StoreMenuData._why: Real-money and ad tabs (packages, incl. the Power Up Package added in 2025, diamonds, headphones, ads, weekly deals) and the store home, whose banners were all real-money offers. Also: burning tickets (4004) and level transfer tickets (4005), which were event items that can't be bought; My Store (6000, server-generated personal offers; the page polls getMyStoreInfo forever); inventory expansion (9000; the inventory size is set by the server, tools/progression.json); the pop-up shop (10000, real-money offers, emptied with PopupStoreData). When the game asks for a store type that no longer has a tab (e.g. 'not enough diamonds'), the libil2cpp patches store-missing-tab-no-crash and store-fallback-card-packs-* open the card packs instead.

StoreHomeData._why: Store home banners; all five linked to real-money tabs (packages, weekly deals, diamonds).
